trail.name: Christian Pond Loop
trail.coordinateNote: Center of the connected Christian Pond route extents, including the Jackson Lake Lodge access spur and shared Emma Matilda segment. Approximate trail-area weather point, not a trailhead or navigation coordinate.

comparison.note: USGS geometry is about 3.505 miles, including the loop and the out-and-back access from Jackson Lake Lodge.

photo.alt: A narrow dirt path winds through golden marsh grasses toward a forested ridge on the Christian Pond Loop.
